capabilities: Move a paragraph to the end of a chosen note by swiping right on it
Pick the destination note in a compact picker window with fuzzy search
Cut the paragraph from its note while the finger travels, leaving a dashed slot until the threshold is reached
Select the nearest paragraph when the swipe lands on a blank line
Configure the swipe threshold and debug toasts in settings
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff, and the README warns it is in active development and testing.
motivation: Made for Android touch screens with no keyboard, so thoughts can be sorted by swiping instead of editing.
problem: Sorting paragraphs into other notes on a touch screen without a keyboard is cumbersome with normal selection and cut-and-paste.
summary: Touch-first plugin that moves a paragraph to the end of another note via a right-swipe gesture and a fuzzy-search note picker.
